ns2:section.sectionText: "Illinois Orchestra Educators Conducting Workshop." Note: This course will meet June 28-30 only. The workshop begins at 1:00 PM on June 28 and concludes at 5:00 PM on June 30. Join other orchestra educator-conductors in a two and a half day workshop led by Donald Schleicher and Louis Bergonzi of the University of Illinois Orchestral Conducting division. As a conductor, you will experience daily lecture-demonstrations, podium time with a small chamber ensemble, and observation of the high school honors orchestra of Illinois Summer Youth Music (ISYM), led by Donald Schleicher. The workshop also includes time for private score study and consultation with faculty on repertoire brought to the workshop. Other repertoire to be studied and the topics examined will be determined based on participants' interest collected via a pre-workshop survey. For more information, visit https://publish.illinois.edu/orchestra-workshop/.
